requirements: R1: Patch GitHub PR synchronization logic to correctly identify and process PRs closed without merge.

slices.title: Patch PR closed status sync logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the PR sync patch for this epic, I want to update the synchronization logic to correctly handle PRs closed without merge, so that the internal task status accurately reflects the actual state on GitHub.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task linked to a GitHub PR,
When the PR is closed without being merged,
Then the internal task status is not marked as done and reflects the unmerged state,
And automated tests verify that unmerged PRs do not trigger a done status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive 'done' status updates for unmerged PRs to 0%
